trips.note: Through train: No. 61 Regina - Melville; No. 61 Melville - Flin Flon. Regina 12.10 p.m. marked b (Tue Thu Sat); continues Melville - Hudson Bay Jn. - The Pas - Flin Flon in sk_cn_t192b.csv (the Winnipeg cars come on No. 3, Table 166, and join at Melville, sk_cn_t192d.csv). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.

Through train: No. 62 Flin Flon - Melville; No. 62 Melville - Regina. Flin Flon 9.00 p.m. and Cranberry Portage 10.38 p.m. marked r (Sun Tue Thu); The Pas and Hudson Bay Jn. marked a (Mon Wed Fri, next morning). From Melville to Regina (sk_cn_t192a.csv) and to Winnipeg (sk_cn_t192d.csv). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.
